title: 3 free tools for AI coding agents
intro: A coding agent is an AI, like Claude Code or Codex, that writes and changes code for you. These free tools help you run more of them, keep their memory, and check their work.
reel: From the reel: Stop babysitting your AI coding agents

tools.name: Worktrunk
tools.what: Gives each agent its own copy of your project, so you can run several at once without them clashing.

copy.label: Install (Mac)
copy.text: brew install worktrunk && wt config shell install

copy.label: Install (any, with Rust)
copy.text: cargo install worktrunk && wt config shell install

tools.name: claude-mem
tools.what: Remembers what your agent did, so the next session starts where you left off. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and more.

copy.label: Turn off usage stats (on by default)

tools.name: Plannotator
tools.what: Shows you the agent's plan before it builds, so you can mark it up and say yes or no.

tools.name: T3 Code
tools.what: Control Claude Code, Codex and more from any computer or your phone.

tools.name: Vibe Kanban
tools.what: A board where you hand tasks to coding agents and watch each one move from to-do to done.

note: The agent writes the code. You still decide what gets built.
sources: Each tool's own GitHub page, checked Nov 17, 2026
